blocks.text: The Names Ar-Rahmaan and Ar-Raheem are two honourable Names which occur numerous times in the Qur'aan. Allaah began Umm al Qur'aan (Sooratul Faatihah) with them, they were made a sign of what Allaah revealed of guidance and clarification. Within them is a speech which the shaytaan cannot take hold of. The Prophet of Allaah Sulaymaan started his letter with them and Jibreel came down with them at the start of every Soorah of the Qur'aan revealing them to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. These two Names both indicate that mercy is an Attribute of Allaah.
Ar-Rahmaan means being described as having mercy. Ar-Raheem means bestowing mercy upon His servants. These two Names indicate perfect and complete mercy which is Allaah's Attribute and description.

In these two Names is a proof of Allaah's perfect mercy which is an all-encompassing Attribute of His. Everything in the higher and lower worlds (the heavens and the earth) that happens such as gaining benefits, liked enjoyable things and good things are from the effects of Allaah's Mercy. Just as what is diverted from them of hateful things: tests, frightening incidents, dangers and harms are from the effects of His Mercy. Good deeds only come from Him and only He can deflect bad deeds and He is the Most Merciful of those who have mercy.

keyPoints: Ar-Rahmaan means being described as having mercy.
Ar-Raheem means bestowing mercy upon His servants.
Both Names indicate that mercy is an Attribute of Allaah, and that His mercy is perfect, complete and all-encompassing.
Allaah began Sooratul Faatihah with them, Sulaymaan started his letter with them, and Jibreel came down with them at the start of every Soorah.
All benefits and good things in the heavens and the earth, and the diverting of tests, dangers and harms, are from the effects of Allaah's Mercy.

recall.q: Which Prophet started his letter with these two Names?
According to the author, what are the effects of Allaah's Mercy in the heavens and the earth?
recall.a: Gaining benefits, liked enjoyable things and good things, as well as the diverting of hateful things such as tests, frightening incidents, dangers and harms.
